decisions.reason: Quantified government use and connections to over 30 APIS schemes keep results well above aspiration in the firm's core aviation business, so there is no reason to search for other uses of its resources.

Post-pandemic demand for travel health data remains weak and no results are reported, putting it below aspiration, but its low running cost as an API and the expanding firm's slack allow one more period before problemistic search forces a reallocation.
A cheap training module that fits the certified-trainer offer and meets growing cyber awareness demand is easily carried by slack even without reported results.
Behaviour analysis extends the firm's specialist detection capability and its innovation strategy for airports, so uncertain results are tolerated while the firm expands.
Document verification complements the successful passenger data solution and sits close to the core offer, so pending results are acceptable given the firm's slack.
